writing_framework.policy: Use script_packaging_coordination and references/script-packaging-coordination.md as the unified development sequence. Complete the existing story card's adapted episode spine before continuous narration; treat its opening, early progress, evidence chain, consequential middle, supported implication and earned answer as diagnostic stages, not compulsory sections or fixed order. Adapt the carrier to the live channel format and evidence; combine or omit stages that do not advance the central question. Compare title/thumbnail/opening concepts before long narration; review actual speech and package together before approval. No compulsory delayed payoff, cliffhanger, chapter count, interrupt timer or performance guarantee. Retain exact narration approval.

script_packaging_coordination.draft_diagnostics_policy: Exact repeats and mapping structure only; manually check semantic repetition, hook truth, changed scene details, science and source strength. Include title, one-line thumbnail concept and passage-level visual/source feasibility notes. No automatic factual verification, production or approval.
script_packaging_coordination.policy: Use existing shortlist/story/marketing records. Develop package concepts before long narration; recheck actual speech before approval. No mandatory named protagonist, danger, myth, surprise timer, autocomplete gate or view/subscriber threshold. Preserve live scope, runtime, Chibi style and approved production.

narration_dna.persona: A curious, clear documentary storyteller whose tone, structure and visual carrier follow the selected channel and researched question.
narration_dna.opening: Open on a supported action, object, habit, pleasure, need or contrast that earns the question. A practical difficulty is optional; do not invent deprivation or danger to fit an opening template.
narration_dna.premise: Answer an evidence-grounded question in the channel's own subject lane. Documentary reconstruction, process explanation, place-led journeys and human-system comparisons are normal formats.
narration_dna.story_progression: concrete question -> evidence-led progression using the channel's narrative grammar -> supported answer -> relevant implications or unresolved limits
story_requirements: a selected topic that fits this channel's focus and audience
one accurate central question and a matching title/opening/payoff promise
primary or authoritative evidence for important facts and mechanisms
progression through event states, flows, thresholds or decisions, as the channel requires
clear geography, time, scale, definitions and material uncertainty
supported reconstruction and explicitly marked illustrative or hypothetical material
an earned answer and relevant consequences or limits
narration_dna.spoken_style: Idiomatic spoken language, concrete nouns, active verbs and varied rhythm. Attach explanation to the action, process or comparison it clarifies. Humor is optional and sensitive passages may be sober. Do not invent real-person testimony or private thoughts. Lead with lived actions, objects and their consequences. Keep source administration and author instructions in notes. Merge repeated qualifications with the same function while retaining uncertainty that changes the answer, scope or inference.
narration_dna.review_requirement: Review the title/thumbnail promise against the first image and the actual first 30 seconds; record the useful progress made by that point. Map the major passage question → evidence/change → updated understanding → next dependency/payoff, and identify any stall caused by repetition, cognitive overload, unclear transitions or unrelated branches. Review full actual speech before prior scores; use separate story /16 and retention /10 passes. Record source/SHA-256, quote opening/consequential middle/ending and verify claimed cuts. Criterion 3 earns 2 only when passages produce distinct, connected advances; criterion 6 earns 2 only when sourced episode particulars carry the consequential middle and payoff in this channel's grammar. A generic explanation with local names earns at most 1 for fit. A missing promised comparison or essential answer blocks recommendation regardless of totals; research or narrow the promise, never raise a score to pass. Label same-author and text/audio limits; scores and shorter runtime do not demonstrate audience performance. Only published audience analytics can describe measured retention.
narration_dna.research_scope: YouTube is dated audience/format discovery, not claim evidence or retention analytics. Verify historical, scientific, economic and institutional claims independently with dates and jurisdiction where relevant.
narration_dna.scenario_policy: A what-if, intervention mission or alternate timeline is optional only when selected for this episode. Mark divergence and assumptions; do not impose a mission, traveler, success criterion or fictional aftermath on a documented explainer.
narration_dna.runtime_revision: Develop supported events, mechanisms, comparisons or consequences; do not pad or slow audio. Approved narration revisions require fresh approval.
narration_dna.authoring_source: Active six-channel config and scripting-dna.md supersede all earlier mission/traveler defaults. Archived profiles are for legacy production lookup only.
narration_dna.topic_continuity: Never infer a new episode topic from old pilots, approved assets or retired channel profiles.
narration_dna.benchmark_policy: Compare actual passages with dated, classified reference evidence; report self-review separately from measured audience results.
narration_dna.narration_boundary: Keep access logs, abstract-only reading status, tool limitations and instructions to the author in the dossier/review. Speak consequential uncertainty, scope and assumptions naturally at the claim. Narrate investigative methods when a finding changes the causal explanation; narrow or research an unsupported claim rather than excuse it with a disclaimer.
narration_dna.premise_isolation: Reuse plot fields only when saved DNA revision, editorial revision and channel format match, or an explicit episode format exception exists. Preserve incompatible recorded premises as production history; only period/place orient the fresh scaffold.
narration_dna.passage_progression: Identify what the viewer can now explain, distinguish or predict that was unavailable before this passage, and the evidence or explanatory step that supplies it. A new study, term, qualification or paraphrase of the same answer is not progress by itself. Keep useful general mechanism and orientation, but merge passages whose removal loses no distinct understanding or necessary scope.
narration_dna.concrete_payoff: Show the supported outcome and its local or everyday consequence; a promise to follow a flow or comparison must be visible in the actual text. Do not fill an evidence gap with invented people, motives or outcomes.
narration_dna.spoken_information_order: Establish the job or constraint before technical names. Use numbers for a meaningful scale, threshold or difference; retain material date, jurisdiction and definitions at the affected claim rather than narrating an unusable data comparison.
narration_dna.ending_test: Close once the supported answer and relevant consequence or uncertainty are clear. A callback is optional and useful only when its meaning has changed; do not re-tour the route or stack several conclusions. A discussion question is optional after the payoff, not a substitute for it.
narration_dna.transition_policy: Distinguish a sourced causal consequence, an explanatory prerequisite and the next task in the same system. Do not invent surprise, discovery order, crisis, private thoughts or a claim that the first solution caused the next problem.
narration_dna.answer_timing: The main answer may arrive early or late. Each intervening passage must pay a useful question. Later branches must serve the title/opening promise or a demonstrated consequence; no fixed teaser interval or mandatory new danger.
narration_dna.runtime_planning: Use the live channel's measured voice/language calibration only when voice, settings and counting method match. It is a provisional drafting budget, not a duration guarantee; confirm approved native-speed TTS before images. Do not infer speech duration from shot budgets, pad repetition, stretch audio or override an accepted episode runtime.
narration_dna.promise_evidence_fit: Choose the episode promise from the evidence available before drafting. Record which observations, process records or bounded results support the essential answer and what remains unknown. Research a missing essential link or narrow the promise within the agreed subject; do not silently change episode identity or invent a demonstration to fill the gap.
narration_dna.situated_mechanism: Connect essential general explanation to a sourced condition, action, finding or outcome in this episode's place, event or service task. The consequential middle must depend on those particulars. A place/name substitution test diagnoses a generic spine, but does not prohibit general science or require a field measurement in every paragraph.
narration_dna.comparison_scope: Only when the promise contrasts outcomes, show the actual named or clearly bounded sides, relevant conditions and supported difference. Check comparable definitions, periods and methods before making causal or numerical comparisons. A regional trend or general mechanism cannot stand in for a missing site-specific comparison; labeled illustration explains a rule but cannot prove an observed outcome. A non-comparative question needs no compulsory second case.
narration_dna.viewer_guidance: Use psychology to guide attention and comprehension: align title/thumbnail with the opening; confirm the click and deliver useful, verified progress within roughly the first 30 seconds; map each major passage as active viewer question → sourced evidence or event change → updated understanding → next question or dependency. Pay partial answers when evidence permits; keep no question open merely to delay its answer. Orient at meaningful changes of time, place, task, state or model, and introduce terms/numbers when their purpose is clear. Close the promise once with the supported consequence or limit. This is a writing method, not a retention guarantee or fixed schedule of hooks, chapters or visual interruptions.
narration_dna.curiosity_path: Before drafting, write the central question and its answerable subquestions. For each major passage, name the evidence that advances or pays one subquestion and the next question that follows from that evidence. If no distinct understanding or necessary scope is lost by deleting a passage, merge or cut it. A missing answer is not a cliffhanger unless the evidence genuinely requires another step.
narration_dna.cognitive_load: Orient the viewer to the place, time, task or current state before adding a new causal relation. Explain technical terms after their practical role is clear; keep numbers that support scale, threshold or difference. Use a still, map, comparison or cross-section to clarify the same relation as narration. Do not use image changes, pan/zoom, on-screen text or pacing tricks as substitutes for clear explanation.
narration_dna.audience_feedback: After publication, use actual YouTube Studio retention by video, including the 30-second intro and dips, spikes and top moments. Match each signal to the exact narration and visuals; a spike may reflect interest, sharing or confusion. Compare similar lengths and traffic sources where data allows. Report observed analytics separately from text review and hypotheses; scores do not predict retention.
narration_dna.narrative_path_policy: Use the live channel progression as a diagnostic guide, not fixed chapters or an identical opening for every episode. Keep question maps, review labels and source administration in notes. Write connected spoken explanation through concrete supported tasks, objects and findings; each passage adds distinct understanding. Choose order from the evidence and viewer question; do not pad to the 12-20 minute target. One central viewer question, not necessarily one physical operation. Connected routines must each contribute a distinct necessary answer within a bounded community and period, preserving the channel lens. A day is optional, not a dawn-to-night checklist.

topic_scope.selection_rule: Prioritize one recognizable everyday-life question in prehistory, Ice Age communities, early farming or antiquity. A focused task is the default; connected routines may answer one coherent lived-experience question. Bound place, period, community and material social variation; do not assemble a universal ancient day from incompatible cases. Later-period or present-day main subjects require an explicit user exception. Modern comparisons are explanatory bridges.

channels.narration_direction: Mở bằng hành động, vật dụng, thói quen, niềm vui, nhu cầu hoặc khác biệt có bằng chứng trong đời sống tiền sử hay cổ đại, gắn với điều kiện địa lý cụ thể; không bắt buộc có khó khăn. Kể gần gũi, tò mò, dí dỏm nhẹ qua vật dụng, hành động và cách xoay xở có bằng chứng. Cái vui đến từ so sánh quen thuộc, vướng mắc thực tế và chi tiết bất ngờ. Không kể như bài giảng, ép chỉ tiêu câu đùa, bịa lời thoại hay tâm lý, chế giễu văn hóa hoặc biến người xưa thành ngốc nghếch. Nói rõ điều chưa chắc ngay khi cần; hồ sơ nguồn để trong ghi chú.

channels.ending_payoff: Answer the original question with the supported change in human life and material limits. Return to an opening object only when its meaning changes.
channels.topic_policy: Prioritize one recognizable everyday-life question in prehistory, Ice Age communities, early farming or antiquity. A focused task is the default; connected routines may answer one coherent lived-experience question. Bound place, period, community and material social variation; do not assemble a universal ancient day from incompatible cases. Later-period or present-day main subjects require an explicit user exception. Modern comparisons are explanatory bridges. These three user-borrowed subjects demonstrate tone only. Do not select, translate, paraphrase or narrow them into episode candidates. Other Egyptian, clothing or household subjects remain possible.

packaging_direction.title_direction: Name one everyday task, habit or inconvenience and its supported early setting. Use an immediately understandable curious question, localized naturally. Avoid abstract scholarly surveys, fixed headline formulas or unverified assumptions that every ancient group lacked an object or practice.
title_patterns: Người [nơi chốn/thời kỳ cổ] [việc đời thường] bằng cách nào?
Sống giữa [điều kiện địa lý thời xưa], họ [việc cụ thể] thế nào?
Vì sao người [cộng đồng cổ] lại [thói quen thích nghi cụ thể]?
packaging_direction.thumbnail_direction: Thumbnail: exactly one emotional Original Chibi 2D character in the centre, doing or reacting to the researched everyday task, with one supported object. No diagrams, arrows, route maps or cutaways on the thumbnail; the one core mechanism diagram stays inside the video. Draw only sourced details. No generic shock face, fabricated comic event presented as history or modern-prop anachronism. Setting: the specific landscape (river, mountain, coast) the community adapted to. Tone: cute, humorous, slightly mischievous, exaggerated expression; never mock real people.
thumbnail_approaches: Nhân vật Chibi đang cư trú, làm việc hoặc di chuyển; cho thấy rõ điều kiện địa lý liên quan.
Ngôi nhà, trang phục hoặc phương tiện gắn với một hành động thích nghi có bằng chứng.
Một nhân vật Chibi ở giữa khung, biểu cảm rõ, phản ứng với sự thật bất ngờ có nguồn của tập.
packaging_direction.text_role: At most 3 words (a number and its unit count as two), one line if possible. A surprising true claim quoted from the script (record text_source_line), never a question about an object, and it must not repeat the title. A text-free candidate records thumbnail_text as an empty string and thumbnail_text_reason.

writing_contract.opening_task: Mở bằng hành động, vật dụng, thói quen, niềm vui, nhu cầu hoặc khác biệt có bằng chứng trong đời sống tiền sử hay cổ đại, gắn với điều kiện địa lý cụ thể; không bắt buộc có khó khăn.
writing_contract.progression_test: Một câu hỏi đời sống → nơi, thời kỳ và cộng đồng cụ thể → hành động và chi tiết có bằng chứng → mỗi đoạn thêm một hiểu biết riêng → đáp án và giới hạn quan trọng. Có thể theo một việc hoặc nhiều sinh hoạt liên kết; không ép chương mục hay câu chuyện nguồn gốc.
writing_contract.reject: No retired disaster, WWI/WWII-only, medieval-only or infrastructure-only constraint. No fabricated testimony or universal imagined daily life.
writing_contract.boundary: Use natural channel-language speech and clearly bounded historical/geographical scope. Define terms and material uncertainty.
writing_contract.evidence_limit: Record this episode's actual source access, sampled/transcript evidence, coverage and language-review limits. Public metadata does not establish spoken structure; translated captions do not establish original phrasing. Text review is not listening, finished-video QA or measured audience performance. Dated sample weaknesses are provenance, not assumptions about a new episode.
writing_contract.execution_check: Theo một cách cư trú, di chuyển, làm việc hoặc sinh sống tại nơi cụ thể; giải thích con người thích nghi với điều kiện địa lý bằng hành động, vật dụng và quan sát có nguồn. Phân biệt ảnh hưởng của địa lý với lựa chọn văn hóa, lịch sử và điều kiện kinh tế khi có liên quan. Không biến tập thành danh sách địa danh, bài giảng hạ tầng hoặc khẳng định địa lý quyết định mọi hành vi.
writing_contract.promise_evidence_fit: Choose the episode promise from the evidence available before drafting. Record which observations, process records or bounded results support the essential answer and what remains unknown. Research a missing essential link or narrow the promise within the agreed subject; do not silently change episode identity or invent a demonstration to fill the gap.
writing_contract.comparison_scope: Only when the promise contrasts outcomes, show the actual named or clearly bounded sides, relevant conditions and supported difference. Check comparable definitions, periods and methods before making causal or numerical comparisons. A regional trend or general mechanism cannot stand in for a missing site-specific comparison; labeled illustration explains a rule but cannot prove an observed outcome. A non-comparative question needs no compulsory second case.
writing_contract.review_scoring: Review the title/thumbnail promise against the first image and the actual first 30 seconds; record the useful progress made by that point. Map the major passage question → evidence/change → updated understanding → next dependency/payoff, and identify any stall caused by repetition, cognitive overload, unclear transitions or unrelated branches. Review full actual speech before prior scores; use separate story /16 and retention /10 passes. Record source/SHA-256, quote opening/consequential middle/ending and verify claimed cuts. Criterion 3 earns 2 only when passages produce distinct, connected advances; criterion 6 earns 2 only when sourced episode particulars carry the consequential middle and payoff in this channel's grammar. A generic explanation with local names earns at most 1 for fit. A missing promised comparison or essential answer blocks recommendation regardless of totals; research or narrow the promise, never raise a score to pass. Label same-author and text/audio limits; scores and shorter runtime do not demonstrate audience performance. Only published audience analytics can describe measured retention.
writing_contract.viewer_guidance: Use psychology to guide attention and comprehension: align title/thumbnail with the opening; confirm the click and deliver useful, verified progress within roughly the first 30 seconds; map each major passage as active viewer question → sourced evidence or event change → updated understanding → next question or dependency. Pay partial answers when evidence permits; keep no question open merely to delay its answer. Orient at meaningful changes of time, place, task, state or model, and introduce terms/numbers when their purpose is clear. Close the promise once with the supported consequence or limit. This is a writing method, not a retention guarantee or fixed schedule of hooks, chapters or visual interruptions.
writing_contract.curiosity_path: Before drafting, write the central question and its answerable subquestions. For each major passage, name the evidence that advances or pays one subquestion and the next question that follows from that evidence. If no distinct understanding or necessary scope is lost by deleting a passage, merge or cut it. A missing answer is not a cliffhanger unless the evidence genuinely requires another step.
writing_contract.cognitive_load: Orient the viewer to the place, time, task or current state before adding a new causal relation. Explain technical terms after their practical role is clear; keep numbers that support scale, threshold or difference. Use a still, map, comparison or cross-section to clarify the same relation as narration. Do not use image changes, pan/zoom, on-screen text or pacing tricks as substitutes for clear explanation.
writing_contract.audience_feedback: After publication, use actual YouTube Studio retention by video, including the 30-second intro and dips, spikes and top moments. Match each signal to the exact narration and visuals; a spike may reflect interest, sharing or confusion. Compare similar lengths and traffic sources where data allows. Report observed analytics separately from text review and hypotheses; scores do not predict retention.
writing_contract.humor_direction: Kể gần gũi, tò mò, dí dỏm nhẹ qua vật dụng, hành động và cách xoay xở có bằng chứng. Cái vui đến từ so sánh quen thuộc, vướng mắc thực tế và chi tiết bất ngờ. writing_contract.question_scope: One central viewer question, not necessarily one physical operation. Connected routines must each contribute a distinct necessary answer within a bounded community and period, preserving the channel lens. A day is optional, not a dawn-to-night checklist.
writing_contract.narration_boundary: Lead with lived actions, objects and their consequences. Keep source administration and author instructions in notes. Merge repeated qualifications with the same function while retaining uncertainty that changes the answer, scope or inference.
writing_contract.second_person_policy: Second person may invite an explicitly illustrative viewpoint. It does not require a mission, invented protagonist or intervention, and cannot establish private thoughts, a real individual experience or a universal routine.

visual_dna_override.subject_selection: Choose a supported human action or experience that explains the passage; objects, maps and diagrams lead when clearer.
visual_dna_override.character_presence: Actively plan people making, using, learning, exchanging, working and adapting. Give them a clear explanatory task and natural restrained expression. No fixed people ratio, obligatory host or whole-cast requirement.
visual_dna_override.consistency: Bold clean dark outlines, warm luminous colors, gentle painterly surface texture, restrained cel shading, readable silhouettes and clear staging; keep researched period/place-specific clothing, tools, materials and palettes. No copied creator characters or layouts.
visual_dna_override.scene_options: Chibi human scenes, environments, artifacts, maps, timelines, cutaways and process/comparison diagrams.
visual_dna_override.prompt_policy: Use the shared Chibi 2D style prompt for every generated frame, including character-free objects, places, maps and diagrams. Generate distinct Codex imagegen keyframes after narration approval and audio review; record provenance internally.
visual_dna_override.review: Inspect factual scope, meaningful human action, clothing/tools, continuity, exact localized text, phone readability and crop. Illustration is not historical evidence.
visual_dna_override.motion_limit: The still renderer adds camera movement only, not body or object animation; changed physical states require distinct keyframes.

visual_workflow_override.existing_episode_policy: Keep recorded episodes and assets; no automatic migration.

lead_sources: authoritative objects, sites, texts and practices
topic_discovery.market_policy: Classify direct vs adjacent long-form, Shorts, wrong-language, unrelated, reupload and possible own-channel results before comparing. Sparse or irrelevant results are weak evidence for the query, not proof of an empty market. Record age, format, publisher and coverage limits. No invented volumes, views forecasts or success percentages.
topic_discovery.evidence_policy: Public discovery does not verify historical claims or reveal CTR/retention. Verify the essential answer independently, and distinguish metadata, chapters, sampled playback and original vs translated transcript access. A missing essential answer blocks readiness; unknown demand may remain an explicitly labeled editorial experiment.
topic_discovery.decision_policy: Recommend one question with a substantively different alternative and reasons to defer/reject others; state what evidence would reverse the choice. Normally research 3–5 finalists per requested channel, without manufacturing a quota. Recommendations do not bind episodes or approve narration/production.
topic_discovery.feedback_policy: Preserve the hypothesis and exact published version; learn from authorized traffic-source CTR, early/middle retention, watch time and relevant feedback together. Do not revise whole-channel DNA from one low-view upload or empty query.

curiosity_check.policy: Use a recognizable action/object, a truthful gap and a concrete viewer gain. Artifact rarity, specialist names and competitor views alone do not establish curiosity. Verify or reframe false absence/first-ever/crisis premises. This is editorial judgment, not measured demand.

angle_trials.policy: Compare genuinely different treatments of the same bounded subject/evidence, not two title paraphrases. Keep uncertainty in both. Do not create full scripts, TTS or images for the comparison, or label it an audience A/B test. If neither promise is supportable, reframe or defer.

challenge_pass.policy: Same-author second-pass is not independent review. No compulsory objection count or automatic agent delegation. Resolve essential factual/causal/promise blockers before unqualified readiness; unknown demand may stay an explicit experiment.

decision_memory.policy: Consult full/cross-channel history before repeats. Append sourced serious-finalist decisions and changes; keep Agent recommendations, actual selection for development and real published observations distinct. Preserve old reasons, record what changed, and never infer narration approval or unavailable analytics. Memory is provenance, not authoring instructions.
